summary: The git build stamp is baked only into the st2 and st3 binaries (new crate st-build-stamp); a commit that changes no Rust no longer recompiles the library crates

compatibility.detail: Version strings and agentSpecRevision are unchanged in st2 and st3. Libraries read the stamp their binary hands them at start; a process that never sets it (library tests, ci-hooks-install) reports 0.1.0+dev, and its hook receipt is refreshed by the next stamped install. agent_spec::AGENT_SPEC_REVISION moved to st_build_stamp::AGENT_SPEC_REVISION.
